comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Katong Park MRT about 430 m, Dakota MRT about 800 m; closer than 416 of 662 similar developments (the same as 11). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Kong Hwa School about 1,110 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 890 m), more than 132 of 662 similar developments (the same as 18); nearest hawker centre Blk 4a Jalan Batu Hawker Centre/Market about 570 m; nearest park Wilkinson Interim Park about 120 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 510 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 610 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 830 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,030 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,100 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,250 m; Amber House, 31 new sales, about 1,300 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,300 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 321 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 444 new sales and 763 resales (1,207 purchases); new sales were 36.8% of these purchases. Subsales (39) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,060 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 763 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 328 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 763 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 881 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13.4%). Planning-area private resales −4.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
